g.text: HRS longitudinal source-model reconstruction: all 16 fixed effects
Points: three fixed seeds per construction. Diamond: mean. Horizontal segment: seed range. Dashed: exported source coefficient.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: 11,509 synthetic subjects × 4 visits per table. Source coefficients were provided; these are not independent patient-validation results.
